resources.string: Shows what the watch relay is doing
Let the relay run in the background (battery optimisation)
The relay needs the Bluetooth (\"Nearby devices\") permission. Tap Start relay to grant it.
Not seen yet. Long-press BOOT on the watch to open its sync window the first time.
No token saved yet. Paste the server\'s CONVO_INGEST_TOKEN.
Token saved (hidden). Type a new one to replace it.
Server reachable. Enter the token to check it.
OK: server reachable and token accepted.
Server reachable, but the token was rejected (HTTP %1$d).
Start the relay after the phone restarts (if it was running)
Off. Turn it on in Settings to sync a T5 E-Paper PDA.
Not seen yet. Open the pairing window on the T5\'s Status screen the first time.
Sync a T5 E-Paper PDA (briefing, conversations, action items, calendar)
For example http://myserver.example-tailnet.ts.net:7000. Leave it empty to sync without a calendar and checklists.
No token saved. In Odysseus, create an API token with only the \"Calendar\", \"Calendar write\", \"Todos\" and \"Todos write\" permissions, plus insight:read for the T5\'s Today insight (ody_…).
Odysseus token saved (hidden). Type a new one to replace it.
That doesn\'t look like an Odysseus API token (they start with ody_).
The id of your CalDAV calendar in Odysseus. Events added on the T5 are written back to CalDAV only when they go into a CalDAV calendar.
Sync the T5 automatically (turn off while the T5 is off or away)
Enter the Odysseus URL and token first.

resources.string: In Odysseus open Conversations → Pair a phone and scan the code (here, or with the phone\'s camera app and open the link). The phone then uploads the watch\'s recordings and syncs the T5 through Odysseus: no server URLs or tokens to type.
Paired with %1$s as \"%2$s\". Uploads and the T5 now go through Odysseus.
Paired with %1$s. Uploads and the T5 go through Odysseus. Pair again to replace this phone\'s token.
Uploads go straight to the Athena server (below). Pair to send them through Odysseus instead.
Point the camera at the code on Odysseus\' Pair a phone page
No camera permission. Paste the pairing link instead.
The scanner couldn\'t start (%1$s). Scan the code with your phone\'s camera app and open the link, or paste it below.
Pairing link for %1$s. Check that this is your Odysseus, then tap \"Pair with this link\".
No camera app could open the scanner. Paste the link instead.
Send the watch\'s audio and the T5\'s data through Odysseus (paired). Off: straight to the Athena server below.
Pair with Odysseus first, or enter its URL and token in the PDA section.
Only needed when uploads don\'t go through Odysseus.

Audio goes only from the watch to your own servers (Odysseus or Athena). Tokens are encrypted on this phone and never shown, logged or backed up. The camera is used only to scan the pairing code, on the phone; nothing is saved.
